scanNote: 10-mashqda buyum yaqinmi (this/these) yoki uzoqmi (that/those) ekani ko'rsatkich qo'l belgisining o'lchami bilan beriladi. Skanda bu farq aniq emas, shuning uchun kitobdagi ikkita namunaning ketma-ketligi (1 = This/these, 2 = That/those) davom ettirilgan va HAR BIR bandda ikkala variant ham izohda ko'rsatilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. In pairs use the prompts to ask and answer questions, as in the example. Use the prepositions: next to, under, near, behind, in front of and on.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang. Juftlikda berilgan so'zlar yordamida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA — TO'RT QATORLI suhbat:
  SA: Is there a table in the room?
  SB: Yes, there is.
  SA: Where is it?
  SB: It's in front of the fireplace.

Ya'ni har bir buyum uchun IKKI savol beriladi:
  1) BORMI?    → Is there ...? / Are there any ...?
  2) QAYERDA?  → Where is it? / Where are they?

Predloglar: next to, under, near, behind, in front of, on
Har biri BIR MARTA ishlatiladi — oltita buyum, oltita predlog.

RASMDA: mehmonxona. Chapda katta qora kamin, uning tepasida
dumaloq bezak, yonida chiroq; o'rtada oyna stol; stol ostida gilam;
o'ngda yostiqchali uzun divan; divan orqasida pardali deraza;
deraza yonida devorda rasm.

items.question: Is there a table in the room?
items.answer: Yes, there is. It's in front of the fireplace.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Oyna stol kaminning oldida turibdi.

items.question: Are there any cushions in the room?
items.answer: Yes, there are. They're on the sofa.
items.whyUz: 'cushions' ko'plik → Are there ANY ...? va 'They're'. Yostiqchalar divan ustida.

items.question: Is there a lamp in the room?
items.answer: Yes, there is. It's next to the fireplace.

items.question: Is there a window in the room?
items.answer: Yes, there is. It's behind the sofa.

items.question: Is there a painting in the room?
items.answer: Yes, there is. It's near the window.
items.whyUz: Devordagi rasm derazaga yaqin. painting = suratli rasm (chizilgan).

items.question: Is there a carpet in the room?
items.answer: Yes, there is. It's under the table.

sections.title: Prepositions with places on the map

exercises.explanationUz:
GEOGRAFIYA PREDLOGLARI — aniq qoidasi bor:

  IN the north/south/east/west OF + mamlakat
     Milan is IN the north OF Italy.
     (mamlakat ICHIDAGI qism)

  ON the ... coast OF + mamlakat
     Patras is ON the west coast OF Greece.
     ('coast' = qirg'oq — bu CHIZIQ, yuza → ON)

  IN + hudud/qit'a
     Norway is a country IN northern Europe.

ESLAB QOLING:
  'north' bo'lsa    → IN the north of
  'coast' bo'lsa    → ON the ... coast of

KITOBDAGI KOMPAS: north (shimol), south (janub),
east (sharq), west (g'arb).

QO'SHIMCHA — 'at home' va 'at work':
  Mr Jones isn't AT home. He is AT work.
  Bu turg'un birikmalarda 'the' YO'Q.

items.textEn: 1  Milan is ____ the north of Italy.
items.whyUz: Mamlakatning shimoliy QISMIDA → IN the north of. Milan — Italiya shahri.

items.textEn: 2  Patras is a city ____ the west coast of Greece.
items.whyUz: 'coast' (qirg'oq) bilan doim ON. Patras — Yunoniston shahri.

items.textEn: 3  London is ____ the south of England.
items.whyUz: Mamlakatning janubiy qismida → IN the south of.
Uy raqami yo'q, faqat ko'cha nomi → IN. Raqam bo'lsa 'at' bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 6  San Francisco is ____ the west coast of the USA.
items.whyUz: 'coast' bilan ON. San-Fransisko — Tinch okean qirg'og'ida.

items.textEn: 7  Norway is a country ____ northern Europe.
items.whyUz: Hudud ichida → IN northern Europe. Norvegiya — Shimoliy Yevropada.

items.textEn: 8  Southampton is ____ the south coast of England.
items.whyUz: 'coast' bilan ON. Sautgempton — Angliyaning janubiy qirg'og'idagi port shahar.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  1  This is a car and these are cars.
  2  That is a balloon and those are balloons.

Har bandda BITTA narsa va KO'P narsa rasmi bor.
Gapning ikkala qismi bir xil masofada bo'ladi:
  YAQIN → This is a ... and these are ...
  UZOQ  → That is a ... and those are ...

ASOSIY MAQSAD — UCHTA o'zgarishni birga bajarish:
  olmosh (this→these) + fe'l (is→are) + ot (+s / +es)

KO'PLIK SHAKLLARI (bu betdagi eng muhim qism):
  watch  → watches   (-ch bilan tugaydi → -es)
  glass  → glasses   (-ss bilan tugaydi → -es)
  book   → books
  banana → bananas
  hat    → hats
  lemon  → lemons

example.en: This is a car and these are cars.
That is a balloon and those are balloons.

That is a glass and those are glasses.
This is a book and these are books.

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — 10-mashqning eng muhim qismi: ko'plik yasash.
Ikkitasi -es oladi, qolganlari oddiy -s.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the questions, then, in pairs, read the dialogue aloud.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni to'ldiring, so'ng juftlikda dialogni ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT: A do'kondan velosiped sotib olgan va uni uyiga
yetkazib berishni so'rayapti. B — do'kon xodimi.

B ga uchta narsa kerak:
  1) MANZIL      → What's your address, please?
  2) YOZILISHI   → Can you spell the street name, please?
  3) TELEFON     → Have you got a telephone number?

Bu — Coursebook 22-betdagi 17-mashq bilan BIR XIL uchlik.
Demak bu uchta savol amalda juda ko'p kerak bo'ladi — yodlang.

MULOYIMLIK:
  'please' — har bir so'rovda
  'Certainly.' — 'Albatta' (rasmiy 'Of course')
  'Is that alright?' — 'Shunday bo'ladimi?'
  'That's fine.' — 'Yaxshi, bo'ladi.'

TELEFON: 4772839 — 'four double seven two eight three nine'

lines.textEn: Can you deliver the bicycle to my house?

lines.hintUz: Keyingi javob — uy raqami, ko'cha va shahar
lines.whyUz: Javob '27, Beechwood Lane, Milltown' — manzil. To'liq savol: What's your address, please?
Javob 'B-E-E-C-H-W-O-O-D' — harflar. To'liq savol: Can you spell the street name, please?

lines.textEn: B - E - E - C - H - W - O - O - D.

lines.whyUz: Javob 'Yes, it's 4772839' — telefon raqami. To'liq savol: Have you got a telephone number?

lines.textEn: Okay. We'll bring it on Thursday. Is that alright?
lines.uz: Xo'p. Uni payshanba kuni olib kelamiz. Shunday bo'ladimi?

wordFormation.introUz: Workbook 14-bet — geografiya, ko'plik va muloqot so'zlari.

groups.explanationUz: Shimol/janub so'zlari otdan sifatga o'tganda -ern qo'shimchasini oladi.

groups.ruleUz: IN the north OF ↔ ON the coast OF
groups.explanationUz: Ikkalasi ham joyni ko'rsatadi, lekin predloglari boshqa. Kalit so'zga qarang.

items.derived: ON the west coast of Greece

patterns.formula: Is there a X in the room? — Yes, there is. It's + predlog + Y.
patterns.exampleEn: Is there a table in the room? — Yes, there is. It's in front of the fireplace.
patterns.exampleUz: Xonada stol bormi? — Ha, bor. U kaminning oldida.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikki bosqichli suhbat: avval BORMI, keyin QAYERDA.
Birinchi javobda ot takrorlanmaydi, ikkinchisida 'It' ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: Are there any X? — Yes, there are. They're + predlog + Y.
patterns.exampleEn: Are there any cushions in the room? — Yes, there are. They're on the sofa.
patterns.exampleUz: Xonada yostiqchalar bormi? — Ha, bor. Ular divanda.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik varianti: any + Are there + They're.

patterns.formula: X is IN the north/south OF + mamlakat.
patterns.exampleEn: Milan is in the north of Italy.
patterns.explanationUz: Mamlakat ichidagi qism uchun IN. 'of' shart.

patterns.formula: X is ON the ... coast OF + mamlakat.
patterns.exampleEn: Southampton is on the south coast of England.

patterns.formula: This is a X and these are Xs. / That is a X and those are Xs.
patterns.exampleEn: This is a car and these are cars. That is a balloon and those are balloons.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu mashina, bular esa mashinalar. U shar, ular esa sharlar.
patterns.explanationUz:
Yaqin — this/these, uzoq — that/those.
Uchta o'zgarish: olmosh + fe'l + ot.

patterns.formula: Can you deliver/spell ... , please? — muloyim so'rov.
patterns.exampleEn: Can you deliver the bicycle to my house? Can you spell the street name, please?
patterns.exampleUz: Velosipedni uyimga yetkazib bera olasizmi? Ko'cha nomini harflab ayta olasizmi?
patterns.explanationUz: 'Can you ...?' — muloyim so'rov. 'please' oxirida vergul bilan ajratiladi.
